mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in a month coincides with a 20-day positive S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates rate hikes later in the cycle.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns do not outperform a 5-day moving average baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or inflation reverts below 0.3% within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressures, which precedes a 60-day S&P 500 forward return decline as investors anticipate higher labor costs eroding profit margins.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month
failure_condition: Across 100 such triggered months, cumulative 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from a control set of non-triggered months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% for two consecutive months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it signals resilient consumer demand.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >2% in both current and prior month
failure_condition: In 100 such double-month events, 20-day forward returns are not statistically superior to a 5-day moving average baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 95 triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as it reflects supply-side weakness and potential production slowdowns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95 in the current month
failure_condition: Over 50 triggered events, 20-day forward returns do not revert to positive (cumulative Sharpe ratio < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS rates (below 0.15%) creates a persistent discounting effect, producing a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in lower future funding costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls for three consecutive months below 0.15%
failure_condition: Across 30 such 3-month episodes, 60-day forward returns fail to beat a 5-day rolling baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% in a month accompanied by a simultaneous rise in PAYEMS of more than 0.2% indicates softening labor market, leading to a negative 20-day SPX forward return as expectations of slower wage growth temper optimism.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% AND PAYEMS increases by >0.2% in the same month
failure_condition: In 40 such triggered months, 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than a control set (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two consecutive months of RSAFS retail sales above 450 million dollars (seasonally adjusted) with no prior month above 400 million indicates a sustained demand surge, producing a positive 60-day SPX forward return as investors anticipate continued strength.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 450M for two consecutive months and prior month ≤ 400M
failure_condition: Over 20 such double-month events, 60-day forward returns do not beat a 20-day moving average baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime shift to a supply-constrained environment (e.g., INDPRO remains below 100 for three consecutive months while HOUST rises by >1%) predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as profit expectations are compressed.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100 for three consecutive months AND HOUST increases by >1% in the current month
failure_condition: Across 15 such episodes, 20-day forward returns do not exhibit a statistically significant negative skew (Kolmogorov-Smirnov p > 0.05).
